description: Machine-readable M0 gate results (I05). Outcomes: PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL, NOT RUN. Narrative in results.md, decision in decision.md.

G1.caveat: Passes only with post-save patches over OfficeIMO.Visio 3.4.4 (connector glue, group formulas, page units, string cells, pictures). OfficeIMO output alone is not usable.
G1.manualChecker: Ralph (user), real Visio and Word, 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-17
commands: VSDX_SAVED=<copy of visio-saved-v7.vsdx> dotnet test spikes/vsdx.tests/VsdxProbe.Tests.csproj --no-build
limitations: Change Picture is not offered in this Visio build, so picture replacement was not exercised through the UI
Connector route probed was straight with glue; an orthogonal connector with user waypoints was not tested in Visio
Layer hide/lock/no-print behaviour, alpha fill, contain-fit image, hidden shape, document identity, copy/paste identity collisions and group angle normalisation were not probed
33 degree rotation is asserted on the generated file only; the Visio-saved file was rotated by hand and the rotation assertion is skipped there
Geometry was not compared to 0.01 pt / 0.01 degrees between generated and Visio-saved files
maxGraph 0.24.0 throws on Escape during a rotate drag; worked around in the probe
begin/cancel gesture events are derived from handler internals, not an official maxGraph API

G3.manualChecker: none needed (real MCP client over stdio)
limitations: ACL and same-user peer checks verified; refusal of a different user needs a second account and was not run
Pipe-name collision behaviour implemented but not separately tested
Only render-process failure was exercised, not browser-process failure
Dispatcher behaviour under a slow page not measured
